snippet.title: Prototype Trailer - BARREL ROLL - Rubika
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860590/Barrel_Roll/

A six-shooter at your side. Half a dozen bullets in the chamber. A wide brimmed hat firmly on your head and galactic gangsters to take down. That’s the cowboy who takes center stage in Barrel Roll, a turn-based combat game with a roguelike structure.
During battles against outlaws, handling the revolver’s barrel rotation and managing its bullets will be crucial in the adventures of our quick draw protagonist, as each bullet has its own unique effect.
If you choose to step into the boots of this robotic gunslinger, you’ll have to overcome these challenges to collect bounties on increasingly dangerous bandits, until you become the greatest bounty hunter in the galaxy.

Barrel Roll is a turn based, roguelike, taking place in a futuristic far west. Gather bullets with special effects, customize your revolver's barrel to create strong synergies and take down as much criminal as you can. Don't forget to reload... If you have to of course !  

This version of Barrel Roll is still a prototype in production.

Barrel Roll is a student prototype made possible thanks to these dedicated devs: 
🖌️ 5 game artists 🖌️
Jean-Malo Sourisse
Julia Ionas
Ged Loewenguth
Louis Leroy
Ernest Lanoy
Léontine Lorilliere
Thaïs Descamps
Marion Lassal

⚙️ 2 game programmers ⚙️
Arthur Perignon
Guillaume Piette

✏️ 4 game designers ✏️
Ethan Dehay
Enzo Gonen
Ewenn Roux
Marie Vallée
Antoine Dubuc.
